description: An ordinary chat request that carries an Origin header: CORS headers on the reply and what reaches the upstream.

headers.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type, X-Api-Key, X-Goog-Api-Key, Anthropic-Version, Anthropic-Beta
headers.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
headers.Access-Control-Expose-Headers: X-CPA-TRACE-ID, X-CPA-VERSION, X-CPA-COMMIT, X-CPA-BUILD-DATE, X-CPA-SUPPORT-PLUGIN, X-CPA-HOME-VERSION, X-CPA-HOME-BUILD-DATE, X-SERVER-VERSION, X-SERVER-BUILD-DATE, Location, Retry-After, ETag, X-Request-Id, OpenAI-Request-Id

exceptions.reason: With CORS turned on for every origin, the new core lists the methods its client routes take (GET, POST, OPTIONS); today's core also lists PUT, PATCH and DELETE, which no client route of the new core takes.
The new core exposes the headers its client replies carry (the trace ID and Retry-After); today's core also exposes its version and build headers and others its client replies do not send.
